name: Semantic Directionality Trap
description: Framing a mathematically symmetric constraint (inequality) within a highly directional narrative (unidirectional data streams). This tricks pattern-matching models into building a directed adjacency list for their backtracking solvers. Consequently, they only check forward edges during assignment, missing conflicts with already-assigned incoming nodes, which leads to invalid outputs (Wrong Answer) or ineffective heuristics (Time Limit Exceeded).
